source.title: Cortical Areas Interact through a Communication Subspace

confidence_rationale: Peer-reviewed, canonical origin of the communication-subspace construct, verified via PubMed (PMID 30770252). It establishes the biological existence of the phenomenon MECH-537 names: V2 reads only a subset of V1 population patterns, and that subset is distinct from the dominant within-V1 fluctuation directions. Confidence held at 0.72 rather than higher because the paper is about trial-to-trial fluctuations in anaesthetised-and-awake macaque V1-V2 under visual stimulation, not about a task variable being encoded-but-not-exposed, so the 'encoded but not routed' phenotype MECH-537 predicts is implied by the geometry rather than demonstrated as a behavioural failure.
failure_signatures: If a downstream area's input were found to be a non-selective, near-full-rank read of the upstream population, the communication-subspace premise of MECH-537 would have no biological anchor; Semedo et al. report the opposite (V2 couples to a subset of V1 patterns separate from dominant within-V1 modes) but only for V1-V2 in macaque.

The subspace is estimated by reduced-rank regression on shared trial-to-trial variability; a REE diagnostic that estimated it from stimulus-driven mean responses instead would be measuring a different object.

mapping.source_claim_statement: Trial-to-trial fluctuations of V1 population responses relate to simultaneously recorded V2 responses through a low-dimensional 'communication subspace': V2 activity connects to only a subset of V1 patterns, separate from the dominant within-V1 fluctuations, whereas interactions between subpopulations within V1 are less selective. The authors propose this as a general population-level mechanism for selective routing across areas.
mapping.ree_translation: This is the existence proof for the object MECH-537 is built on: a sender population can carry many directions of variance while a consumer reads only a low-rank subset, and the read subset need not coincide with the sender's dominant directions. ARC-139's federation picture (private high-dimensional representation, low-dimensional consumer-facing interface) is the architectural generalisation of this finding. The reduced-rank-regression estimator the paper uses is the same estimator MECH-537's registered diagnostic specifies.
mapping.mapping_caveat: The paper shows selective LOW-RANK coupling; it does not show a task variable that is decodable from the sender but absent from the consumer-facing subspace with a behavioural consequence, which is the phenotype MECH-537 asserts. That inference is REE's, not Semedo's. Macaque early visual cortex under passive viewing is also a long way from an E1/E2 interface in an embodied agent.
mapping.source_context: Macaque V1 and V2 simultaneous population recordings (Utah arrays), visual stimulation; reduced-rank regression on trial-to-trial variability.

confidence_components.notes: High source quality: Neuron, widely replicated construct (Kohn et al. 2020 TINS review, PMID 32771224, extends it). Mapping fidelity mid: the construct maps cleanly, the failure phenotype does not. Transfer risk moderate-high for the reasons in the caveat.
